mentions.name: Survival game (Minecraft/Valheim-style)
mentions.description: A survival game inspired by Minecraft, Valheim, and Vintage Story, focused on survival core mechanics including building and fighting. Development is in the final phase of wiring all the game systems together, with the process streamed daily on Twitch.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a survival game in the line of MC, Valheim and Vintage Story. Last months have been focused on developing the survival core mechanics on top of building and fighting. Im now entering in the final phase of wiring all the pieces together. Streaming the process daily on Twitch.
